summary: SEO Phase 4 - Performance Optimization testing completed. All lazy-loaded pages render correctly with React.lazy() code splitting. PageLoader component displays during transitions (data-testid='page-loader' verified). Homepage loads quickly as critical path components (Home, Products, Contact) are not lazy-loaded. All product family pages (LumiMorph, GlassMorph, SignaTouch, NaturaTex, PixelVue) load correctly. Navigation between lazy-loaded routes is smooth with no JavaScript errors.

features_tested.details: 60+ page components lazy-loaded via React.lazy(). All tested routes (Solutions, Blog, Admin, Applications, Knowledge, etc.) render correctly

features_tested.feature: PageLoader component displays during lazy loading
features_tested.details: PageLoader with data-testid='page-loader' verified visible during page transitions

features_tested.feature: Homepage loads quickly (critical path not lazy-loaded)

Solutions page content renders after lazy import
Blog page with articles loads correctly
Admin login form renders with email/password fields
PixelVue iPoster page renders with product specs (40mm thickness, 69kg weight, 16:9 ratio, 3840Hz)
5 images found with loading='lazy' on homepage. Blog, Applications, and Home pages have lazy loading images
No JS errors from React.lazy or code splitting. Only non-critical errors: missing video files (404s) and external CDN blocked requests
Rapid navigation tested across 10+ pages - all loaded successfully including About, Contact, Case Studies, Services, FAQ, Value Engineering, CPD Programme, Design Assist

features_tested.details: All product family pages with named exports lazy-loaded correctly using .then(m => ({ default: m.ComponentName }))
Clicking Products link in navbar successfully navigates to /products page

critical_code_review_comments: Code splitting properly implemented with React.lazy() for 60+ non-critical page components
Critical path components (Home, Products, Contact, NotFound) correctly kept as direct imports
PageLoader component provides good UX during lazy loading with spinning animation and 'Loading' text
LazyImage component includes IntersectionObserver fallback and WebP detection but is not widely used yet - consider using it for more images
Suspense boundary correctly wraps Routes component with PageLoader fallback
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO Phase 4 Performance Optimization is fully implemented. React.lazy() code splitting works for all lazy-loaded routes. PageLoader displays during transitions. Images use native loading='lazy' attribute. The LazyImage component exists but is not widely used yet - it provides additional features like IntersectionObserver fallback and blur-up placeholder.

minor_notes.non_critical_network_errors: Video files (hero-video-new.mp4, hero-video-converted.mp4) return 404. External CDN image (files.ihgbrands.com) blocked by ORB. These are pre-existing issues not related to SEO Phase 4.
minor_notes.images_without_loading_attr: 13 images on homepage don't have explicit loading attribute but default browser behavior is okay for above-fold images
